1.label: very_easy
1.summary: Reconcile two objects across the two projection seals. The carousel moves slowly, the settle drift is small, and generous position and depth margins make the first observe-adjust-settle loop easy to recover.
1.natural_language: Move the two objects from the carousel to the worktable. Match their FRONT and SIDE marks, watch the small force-settle drift, then certify the settled sculpture.

2.label: easy
2.summary: Reconcile three objects with distinct depths. A slower carousel and moderate settle vectors leave room to read both projections and correct one object at a time.
2.natural_language: Move all three objects from the carousel to the worktable. Match both projection seals, observe the force-settle drift, then certify the settled sculpture.

3.label: medium
3.summary: Reconcile four different objects while depth and vertical placement must agree in both seals. The carousel and settle inspection approach the reference configuration.
3.natural_language: Move all four objects from the carousel to the worktable. Make both live projection seals coincide, account for the force-settle drift, then certify the settled sculpture.

4.label: hard
4.summary: The original five-object configuration: a moving carousel, five distinct depths, two simultaneous projection seals, visible eight-tick force settling, and 11 px/3-depth acceptance margins.
4.natural_language: Move all five objects from the rotating carousel to the worktable. Make the live solid marks coincide with the target outlines in both FRONT (X/Y) and SIDE (depth/Y) seals, anticipate the visible force drift, then certify the settled sculpture.

5.label: very_hard
5.summary: The same five-object sculpture must be calibrated with faster carousel acquisition, larger force drift, and tighter two-view coincidence margins. Small pre-settle errors compound across the final inspection.
5.natural_language: Move all five objects from the fast carousel to the worktable. Calibrate every FRONT and SIDE projection tightly enough to survive the stronger force-settle inspection, then certify the settled sculpture.

simplified.summary: Click an object, then click its worktable destination; adjust depth with labelled front/rear step buttons. The same carousel, projection seals, force settling, geometry, and pass condition remain in effect.

full.summary: Drag every object from the moving carousel or worktable and drag the depth rail directly. This is the original interface.
